name: pey.sync
description: Generic user-configured sync for pey.storage collections (first backend: git)

provides.name: pey.sync.service
provides.description: Manual, backend-neutral sync of storage collections to user-chosen remotes

methods.name: configureBackend
methods.description: Validates and stores one backend (kind plus its params); reports without secrets

methods.name: removeBackend
methods.description: Clears credentials and sync state without touching local data

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Configured or not (never the secret), last sync time, last error

methods.name: hasPendingChanges
methods.description: Reports local news against the last snapshot without any network (drives the dirty indicator)

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Pushes local news, pulls remote news, stops on first conflicts (path identity: no remote metadata files)

methods.name: resolveConflict
methods.description: Applies one side for a single conflict; clock advances when none remain

events.name: sync:changed
events.description: Published after every run, complete or partial.

events.name: sync:conflicts
events.description: Published when a run stops on conflicts, for the host prompt.
